stops.note: the indigenous Ainu name for the edible kelp harvested off Hokkaido
trade ships carried kombu from Hokkaido to Osaka along the 'kombu road'
Kikunae Ikeda discovered the savoury taste umami in kombu broth in 1908
stops.meaning: dried edible kelp used to make Japanese broth

current_meaning: an edible kelp, dried and used to make the savory Japanese stock called dashi
